notes.text: SUB-SECTORS (Art. 46 of the renewal 2024-2027 signed 18 February 2025, pp. 21-22; verbale of 21 February 2025, pp. 24-25): the calzature, giocattoli, occhiali and pelli e cuoio tables are modelled as the base_salary_by_subsector calzature, giocattoli, occhiali and pelli_cuoio (EmployerProfile.subsector), the occhiali and pelli e cuoio ones from the replacement tables of the verbale; level 4s exists only in the last three. Not modelled: the penne, spazzole e pennarelli table (pp. 22 and 24, with a 4S level). The levels the tables of giocattoli, occhiali and pelli e cuoio do not print (2bis, 3bis and 8; 7 also for occhiali and pelli e cuoio) are paid the tessile table when requested with those sub-sectors, and every level of the four sub-sectors takes the tessile seniority amounts.

limitation.remediation: Model the penne, spazzole e pennarelli table, source the seniority of the sub-sectors and reject the levels their tables lack, then remove this note.

notes.text: VV.PP. (Venditori Viaggiatori e Piazzisti) levels excluded; only Jan-2026 data available from primary sources, historical tranches not found.
APPRENTICESHIP: not modelled (set to []). Primary source for post-2024 apprenticeship rules not identified.
SALARY MODEL: conglobated (single minimo mensile, no separate contingenza or EDR). Source: lavoro-economia.it explicitly divides monthly by 173 to derive hourly rate, no separate component columns.
LEVEL 1: jumps to 1558.00 EUR/month at Jan 2025 (9.006 EUR/h, exceeds 9 EUR/h floor per CCNL art. 33bis). Frozen in Jan 2026 and Jan 2027 — excluded from standard tranche mechanism.
LEVEL 8 IDF: indennità di funzione 51.65 EUR modelled as fixed_allowance (unverified for period before Jan 2026). Function-conditional, not automatic for all L8 workers.

limitation.remediation: Gate IND_FUN by a role (function holders) and source the pre-Jan 2026 amount, or record the limitation.

notes.text: FONDAPI: the contributions are computed on the contractual minimum of the level; the Fondapi base also counts the EDR, not in the bundle pay.

The Fondapi base ('retribuzione Fondapi' or 'elemento retributivo nazionale') counts the EDR besides the minimum; the bundle pay of this CCNL does not hold them, so the fund contributions of an enrolled worker are computed on the minimum alone and understated.

limitation.remediation: Model the EDR in the pay of the CCNL and add them to the Fondapi base, then remove this note.

notes.text: LEVEL 4s (pelli e cuoio, occhiali, giocattoli): the seniority table of the file has no 4s row and the art. 46 tables read do not set one, so a 4s worker accrues no seniority increments. No fixed allowance is modelled for it (the tables read set none), and its category is left to Employment.category.

limitation.remediation: Source the seniority increment of level 4s, add it to amount_by_level, then remove this note.

notes.text: Art. 12 bis: the elemento di garanzia retributiva is owed to the worker in service on 1 January and paid with the June pay; the text does not say whether a worker who leaves between January and June is paid it with the final settlement. The engine pays it only in the regular run of June.

limitation.remediation: Read an authoritative interpretation of art. 12 bis for a termination before June and settle the element there if owed.

notes.text: Art. 12 ter: from 2020, in the firms that have not applied art. 12 letter C (a company premio di risultato), 110 EUR gross with the June pay to every worker in service in that month, in twelfths, a company agreement paying less topped up to 110. Not modelled: the bundle holds one yearly element per CCNL (the EGR of art. 12 bis).

limitation.remediation: Model a second yearly element with eligibility in the month of payment and a top-up of a lower company amount.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.
Confidence set to needs_review: values to re-check.

reviews.scope: The minimi of the ten levels of the settore tessili e abbigliamento against the signed renewal of 18 February 2025.
findings: Settore tessili e abbigliamento (PDF p. 21 of the signed scan, checked on the page image): the 38 minimi of the file, from the minimi of 1/02/2022 to 1/01/2027, match and move from assumed to verified. Level 1 is a flat 1.558,00 from 2025 with no increment printed. The errata of 21/2/2025 (pp. 24-25) does not touch this table.
The ruleset names this source, published by FILCTEM-CGIL, a signatory: source_type contracting_party instead of estimated.

reviews.scope: Art. 46 calzature table of the renewal 2024-2027 (p. 21, page image).
findings: The calzature employers pay their own minimi (level 8 2,431.61 from 2025, not the tessile 2,421.56).

reviews.scope: The giocattoli table of art. 46 (p. 22) and the occhiali and pelli e cuoio replacement tables of the verbale of 21 February 2025 (pp. 24-25), page images.
findings: Giocattoli (p. 22), occhiali (p. 24) and pelli e cuoio (p. 25): the 88 minimi, from the minimi of 1/02/2022 to 1/01/2027, read on the page images and added as the base_salary_by_subsector of levels 1-7 and the new sub-sector level 4s.

The verbale moves the last occhiali tranche to 1/01/2027 (p. 22 printed 1/02/2027) and corrects the pelli e cuoio level 6; pelli e cuoio level 1 is printed 1.557,00 in 2025 and 1.558,00 from 2026, kept as printed.

reviews.scope: Art. 12 bis and 12 ter of the renewal of 24 January 2020 (CNEL deposito 118136, PDF p. 12), the renewal of 18 February 2025 (deposito 216349) for amendments.
findings: Art. 12 bis: 240 EUR a year from 2017, with the June pay from 2021, to the worker in service on 1 January without company bargaining or individual treatment; twelfths of the year before, part-time proportional, all-inclusive including the TFR.
The text is silent on a termination before June: limitation egr_termination_before_june.
Art. 12 ter (110 EUR, firms without art. 12 C) left as limitation art_12_ter_element.
The renewal of 18 February 2025 does not amend art. 12, 12 bis or 12 ter.

location.section: Art. 12 bis - Elemento di garanzia retributiva
location.quote: a favore dei lavoratori dipendenti da aziende prive della contrattazione aziendale stessa e che non percepiscono altri trattamenti economici individuali o collettivi oltre a quanto spettante in base al presente contratto nazionale, sarà riconosciuto un importo a titolo di "elemento di garanzia retributiva". Tale importo, pari a 220 euro lordi ed elevato ad euro 240 dal 1° gennaio 2017, uguale per tutti i lavoratori, sarà erogato con la retribuzione del mese di gennaio di ogni anno ai lavoratori in forza il 1° gennaio dello stesso anno di erogazione ed aventi titolo in base alla situazione retributiva individuale. Con decorrenza dall'anno 2021, tale importo sarà erogato con la retribuzione del mese di giugno di ogni anno. L'importo del E.G.R., che è da intendersi omnicomprensivo di ogni incidenza su tutti gli istituti legali e contrattuali, compreso il TFR, sarà corrisposto interamente ai lavoratori in forza dal 1° gennaio al 31 dicembre di ogni anno precedente l'erogazione e proporzionalmente ridotto in dodicesimi per gli altri lavoratori, considerando come mese intero la frazione di mese superiore a 15 giorni. Sarà altresì riproporzionato per i lavoratori a tempo parziale in base al minor orario contrattuale.

provenance.transformation: EUR 240 a year with the June pay to the worker in service on 1 January, in twelfths of the months of the year before (more than 15 days a whole month), in proportion to the part-time hours; all-inclusive, out of the TFR. A firm with company bargaining (EmployerProfile.second_level_premium or second_level_elements) or any individual element of the worker (Employment.individual_elements) closes it. The 2025 renewal (CNEL deposito 216349) does not amend art. 12 bis. A termination before June does not pay it: limitation egr_termination_before_june.
